description: Built-in AtCoder Better and Codeforces Better enhancements for the integrated browser.
atcoder: Enable AtCoder Better in the integrated browser. Reload open pages after changing this setting. Configure its features with the Better settings button on the website.
codeforces: Enable Codeforces Better in the integrated browser. Reload open pages after changing this setting. Configure its features with the Better settings button on the website.
